title: US rates: Rise of the Planet of the Rates

classification.rationale: The note extends a short 30y UST trade, driven by futures CTD switch convexity risk and an expected fall in unemployment to 4%, so its main purpose is a long-end duration and curve view.
classification.runner_up_reason: Fiscal worries and the 'rate expectations' component of back-end yields touch on term premium, but the core argument is futures CTD mechanics and a specific trade.
